purpose: Ingest mixed-domain sources surfaced by the post-coverage 67500/67930/76597/77967/95324 multiplicity pass, emphasizing information-disclosure testing, civil/maritime illumination, dependency governance, software obfuscation, AI adoption dynamics, filesystem-boundary security and connector qualification.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, standard, method, software resource, operational precedent, commercial signal or information item receives a Worldshepherd use when it materially improves any capability, or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: NVD/vendor mirrors, standards-reseller copies, preprint/published copies and issue mirrors for the same underlying item are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: CVE IDs, standards numbers, issue IDs, thesis IDs, bug numbers and article identifiers may be useful to Worldshepherd but carry zero automatic Glob evidence unless the digits independently encode a verified physical quantity.

sources.title: CVE-2025-67500 — Mastodon observable response discrepancy
sources.note: Use as an object-existence side-channel test pattern: localization/error response differences can reveal protected-resource existence without revealing content. 67500 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: DIN 67500:2025-08 draft — Illumination of lock areas
sources.note: Use lock-area illumination requirements, design/calculation and measurement as a maritime/civil infrastructure reference. 67500 is the standard number.

sources.title: CVE-2025-67930 — eHive Search reflected XSS
sources.note: Use reflected-XSS input/output handling as a web-interface hardening case; fixed at eHive Search 2.5.1. 67930 is the CVE identifier.

sources.title: A modular approach to compile-time obfuscation using sequential transform passes
sources.note: Use modular LLVM obfuscation passes, annotation-selective application, semantic-preservation validation and performance/complexity benchmarking as a software-protection research reference. 76597 is the thesis repository ID.

sources.title: PHP security bug 77967 — SQLite file URI open_basedir bypass
sources.note: Use as a path/URI policy-boundary test case: alternate resource naming can bypass a filesystem restriction unless every access path shares the same authorization check. 77967 is the bug number.

sources.title: Measuring the Impact of AI on Report-Drafting Efficiency in Chest Computed Tomography Interpretation
sources.note: Use delayed-benefit/adaptation effects as an AI-deployment evaluation precedent: immediate throughput can worsen before learning and workflow integration produce benefit. 77967 is the article identifier.

sources.title: VG 95324 connector detail-standard family
sources.note: Use current printed-board pin/socket and free rectangular connector detail standards as qualification and procurement references. 95324 is the standard-family number.

information_updates.finding: Authorization testing should compare status codes, body shape, localization, timing and other response characteristics for allowed versus denied object queries so protected-resource existence is not leaked through error-channel differences.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Generalized from CVE-2025-67500; no claim that current Worldshepherd endpoints exhibit this flaw.

information_updates.finding: AI productivity evaluation should include operator adaptation and longitudinal throughput rather than assuming deployment-day performance represents steady state. The cited 2026 clinical workflow study observed initial reporting-time increases and later improvement at one hospital after prolonged use.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Use as an evaluation-design precedent; medical outcomes are not generalized to Worldshepherd without local validation.

information_updates.finding: PHP bug 77967 reinforces a recurring security rule already seen in Unicode/path-equivalence cases: authorization must operate on canonical resource identity, not only one textual representation or access API.
information_updates.claims_boundary: This is a security-engineering synthesis, not a relation between numerical identifiers.

next_actions: Continue post-coverage multiplicity sampling and use the analyzer to prioritize states with low namespace diversity rather than only already-dense CVE states.
Add response-discrepancy, canonical-resource-identity and AI-adaptation-curve cases to future Worldshepherd validation plans where applicable, after local implementation context is checked.
Continue same-system topology and relational verification independently for physical P1/P2 candidates, especially W II and Sr I.
Maintain fixed tolerance and experiment-wide multiple-testing/false-discovery controls for physical evidence promotion.
